يستمجد (form X)

# يُسْتَمْجَدُ (yustamjadu) /jus.tam.d͡ʒa.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمْجَدَ (istamjada)
# يَسْتَمْجِدَ (yastamjida) /jas.tam.d͡ʒi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
